agent.finish_summary: Fixed KeyError: None regression in boltons.strutils.MultiReplace/multi_replace when given an empty sub_map. Root cause: with no substitutions, the combined regex pattern became an empty alternation that still matched (with lastgroup=None), causing self.group_map[None] to raise KeyError. Fix: when there are no regex_values, set self.combined_pattern = None in __init__, and in sub() return the text unchanged if combined_pattern is None. Verified multi_replace('The foo bar cat', {}) now returns the text unchanged instead of raising. Non-empty-mapping behavior is unchanged.
